title: Predicting Business Closures in Hawaii
description: An analysis of Google Maps business and review data using data cleaning, feature engineering, hypothesis testing, and machine learning to investigate factors associated with permanent business closures.

title: Promotion Paradox
description: An interactive data visualization exploring the relationship between NYPD officer rank and allegation substantiation rates, demonstrating how different population choices can lead to contrasting conclusions.

title: Diabetes Regression From Scratch
description: Built a diabetes progression prediction model from scratch using linear and ridge regression. Implemented gradient descent, engineered and evaluated nonlinear features, standardized data, and tuned regularization to improve predictive performance.
